Definition: to balance, i.e. measure out (by weight or dimension); figuratively, arrange, equalize, through the idea of levelling (ment. estimate, test)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to regulate, measure, estimate, ponder, balance, make even, level, weigh, be equal, be weighed out, test, prove; 1a) (Qal) estimate (participle); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be estimated; 1b2) to be made even or right, be adjusted to the standard; 1c) (Piel) to weigh out, mete out; 1d) (Pual); 1d1) to be weighed out, be measured out; 1d2) measured out (participle)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
